mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation models, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction effect (measured by the product term) has a negative Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high housing starts (HOUST) indicate overbuilding and potential market saturation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions with HOUST above 1600, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) directly correlates with stronger consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals an imminent economic contraction, causing S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) creates stagflationary conditions that erode corporate margins and investor confidence, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through a negative interaction effect.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 290 and FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a negative Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion and improving corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-recession recoveries with GDPC1 growth above 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
